text:
jess: quick flag during v2 migration QA 10 found docs examples still using top-level "model" in request bodies. runtime shim maps this to an alias which can change the served variant. repro: POST /v2/invoke with body '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"x"}' -> alias resolver picks redwood-13b-gpu, fallback to redwood-7b-quant if gpu pool is full.
omar: that silent fallback causes unexpected quality drops. we need a clear migration note.

jess: proposal: add migration note "Avoid top-level 'model' in v2 payloads"; provide replacements showing model -> model_id, show X-RW-Strict header to enforce. add docs-lint rule to flag occurrences under /docs/v2/.

sam: i'll add the linter and a quickfix script that rewrites examples. branch docs/migrate-model-param. will include unit tests.

tara: docs should also include a short checklist: run scripts/find-legacy-models.sh, run make smoke-migration, and verify alias mapping with scripts/check-model-aliases.sh.

ci-bot: reminder: add docs-lint job to .github/workflows/docs-ci.yml so it runs on PRs.

sam: curl example (primary uses --data-binary for windows-safe):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/invoke \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-RW-Strict: true" \n  --data-binary '{"model_id":"redwood-13b","input":"Summarize..."}'
```

jess: also ping SDK leads. if SDKs map legacy 'model'->'model_id' client-side they should emit a clear warn with link to the guide.

omar: SDK leads said ok, they'll add console.warn / logger.warn in next minor release and coordinate with docs publish.

publish-bot: docs publish window: 2026-03-24T04:30Z pending PR merges.

sam: PR 5902 draft opened with linter, quickfix, updated examples, and redirect entries for 7 legacy pages. CI should catch any remaining occurrences.

jess: i'll review 5902 today. once merged, add short blurb to deprecation notice and schedule follow-up in docs sync. :white_check_mark:

tara: LGTM.
